reviews.text:
Highly recommended for their friendliness, helpfulness, professionalism, and above all, their extensive experience in the field.
Another important detail to consider is the excellent quality/price ratio, with reasonable prices and fast, impeccable service.
I encourage anyone with a furry friend to experience this with Francesca, the owner and primary caretaker. Besides showing love and respect for the world of animals, she offers them profound care and attention.

I have been taking my poodle for a long time and I can assure you that they are excellent, a real miracle. Francesca is very good and very competent. I only find trust in them. I highly recommend them.

My experience with the staff at "La Casa del Cane" is excellent: professionalism, kindness, and helpfulness are hallmarks. Francesca in particular, from day one, has connected with my poodle, who is calm and happy every time he's groomed. She's the best at scissor cutting. Everything is superb!!
I took my dog ​​to Francesca's grooming salon and had a really good experience. The atmosphere was welcoming, the staff were very helpful, and the service was so kind from the very beginning.

I've been entrusting my poodle to Francesca for years, and she's always friendly and available to accommodate my requests.
The perfect cut and attention to detail are a testament to her professionalism.

We visited a dog grooming salon in Naples with our Italian friends. We brought our dogs for a bath and haircut. The salon is great. Everything is done professionally! It feels like Francesco loves dogs and his work. We liked everything!

I took my mixed-breed dog for the first time almost by accident. I immediately found a welcoming place for my little girl, a perfect and super-scented wash, soft fur and no tangles at all.
Even though it's out of my area, I'll definitely go back for their professionalism.

I took my dog ​​to be washed, and I immediately found a welcoming environment that puts our four-legged friends at ease.
Francesca, the owner, is very empathetic and knowledgeable in the field.
I also purchased some products, and her expertise helped me make the best choice.
I will definitely be back.

Just got back with my Brandy clean, smelling good, and happy. Going to France is like being at home. She welcomes you and maybe even scolds you, because the dog (specifically my Brandy) is unwatchable😅... and she's right, his fur is so unkempt and she does it in a way that seems gruff, but which actually hides great empathy and great sweetness because she knows well how complicated it is for us mothers/women to keep up with everything. France knows how to take care of dogs and knows how to take care of their owners. If she sees you down, she looks at you and hugs you with her eyes and brings a smile to your face, if she sees you happy, she shares your happiness. If she does this with people, imagine the effect it has on dogs. She is welcoming, attentive, caring, maternal, and competent. Brandy is always calm, always cared for, and always loved.

I don't know if the accounts that wrote about the owners' rudeness are bots or simply talked to dogs waiting to be washed, thinking they were the shop's owners, but I've been a customer for a decade and in that time I've never, ever witnessed or been wronged by these people. The only flaw I'd like to point out is that they're a bit expensive for grooming, but as for their manners, there's no point in even bringing them up; they've always been affectionate and caring towards me and my dogs.
I took my Cocker Spaniel to the groomer, I had a great time, I found the owner very kind and helpful, I will definitely be back!

Francesca has known my two Golden Retrievers for a while now, and I trust only her.
I work in the industry, so I'm extremely careful about who I entrust my puppies to, and I couldn't have chosen better. Thank you so much for everything.

I've been a customer for 4 years, and I wouldn't change Francesca's expertise and her father's kindness for anything in the world, but I'm sure my white Maltese wouldn't either. For him, they are indispensable and irreplaceable. Thank you, thank you, thank you ♥️

I read many more positive reviews than negative ones, I went there and the negative reviews I read I do not believe are true, my dog ​​was done perfectly as I wanted, it came out smelling great and I will definitely go back ❤️

Today was my first coffee cut, a wonderful experience. He's only 4 months old, and if I'd based my opinion on the reviews, I never would have come! I don't know why these people had such a bad impression, but to me it seemed like the complete opposite. In addition to their professionalism, they also showed great empathy for the dog, and above all, they were a good guide for me, a beginner! Thank you ❤️
You can't leave negative reviews because the system blocks them 😂😂😂 …

I'd already heard from neighborhood gossip about this shop's NEGATIVE reputation and the owners' dislike for it; I've seen it firsthand.
I wonder how it's possible it's still open.

Store to close.
AWFUL

I'm giving it one star because it's not possible to give it 0.
The owners are extremely rude, with little to no attention to those who bring them money.
I STRONGLY discourage this business; there are much better ones out there.

Unfortunately, I have to leave a negative review. I had requested a specific food for my dog, who has special dietary needs, but I was sold the wrong product. Trusting the store staff, I started giving it to him, but after a while, I noticed that my dog ​​continued to lose weight and become weak.
When I returned to report the problem, thinking it was a mistake, not only did I not receive an apology, but I was told that it was the only product they had (so it wasn't a mistake).
For a store that specializes in animal health, I would have expected much more seriousness, attention, and professionalism, but apparently they aren't adequately trained.
don't go there at all
